People: Jonas de Gélieu (author, Wikidata Q118044), died 1827; Clementina Stirling Graham (translator, Wikidata Q16063821), died 1877. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Gélieu, Jonas de, 1740-1827; Graham, Clementina Stirling, 1782-1877 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's (Wikidata gives some of them several death years, every one 1925 or earlier: Jonas de Gélieu [1817, 1827]).

Printed edition: The bee preserver; or, Practical directions for the management and preservation of hives, Edinburgh, J. Anderson, 1829, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/beepreserverorpr00gl. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 60%, 85%, 81% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Clementina Stirling Graham, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
